// scenario for go_perf_layer_data_structure_choice_small_enum_string_switch_map: Layer: Data structure choice. Flag tiny enum-like domains represented by map lookups in hot paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario516Positive(kind string) int {
	lookup := map[string]int{"small": 1, "medium": 2, "large": 3}
	switch kind {
	case "small", "medium", "large":
		return lookup[kind]
	default:
		return 0
	}
}
